clean-read-unique-fanout.title: Clean ReadUnique: two-peer fanout and response join
clean-read-unique-fanout.learning_goal: Fan one ReadUnique out to two clean peers, join both Snoop responses, then commit Unique authority.
clean-read-unique-fanout.model_boundary: Clean MESI authority transfer over a resolved direct topology; no dirty-owner forwarding or performance claim.

dirty-peer-clean-unique.title: CleanUnique: absorb a shared-dirty peer through DAT
dirty-peer-clean-unique.learning_goal: Return shared-dirty peer data on DAT, update Home backing once, and complete CleanUnique with Comp/CompAck.
dirty-peer-clean-unique.model_boundary: Restricted shared-dirty CleanUnique path; not general Owned/SD or DCT behavior.

make-unique-local-intent.title: MakeUnique: dataless permission and local full-line intent
make-unique-local-intent.learning_goal: Obtain Unique permission with a dataless network lifecycle and install the requester's local full-line write intent.
make-unique-local-intent.model_boundary: MakeUnique plus one modeled local store intent; not partial write or arbitrary cache-pipeline behavior.

clean-evict-retry.title: Clean Evict retry, P-Credit and credited reissue
clean-evict-retry.learning_goal: Observe RetryAck, Home P-Credit debt/grant, credited reissue, and the terminal clean Evict completion.
clean-evict-retry.model_boundary: One deterministic successful retry cycle; not general Retry/error composition, fairness, or liveness proof.

writeback-snoop-cancel.title: Dirty WriteBackFull canceled by pre-response same-line Snoop
writeback-snoop-cancel.learning_goal: Delay an emitted dirty WriteBackFull while a same-line invalidating Snoop transfers ownership, then close the late request with zero-byte cancellation data.
writeback-snoop-cancel.model_boundary: Scenario-controlled participant interleaving. Every packet and state transition is model-produced, but transport hop timing is not simulated for this case.
